info.name: ChurchTools Chat
info.description:
**⚠️ Experimental:** This app is still experimental. It may change, be incomplete, or behave unexpectedly. Use it with care and do not rely on it for critical workflows.
ChurchTools Chat brings [ChurchTools](https://church.tools) chat into Nextcloud with a native, Talk-like interface built on Vue 3. Search for people, start direct conversations, and read group context without leaving Nextcloud.
### ✨ Features
* 🔍 **Person search & direct conversations** — find visible ChurchTools people by name and start or reopen a Matrix direct conversation with them * 💬 **Native Vue 3 interface** — a Talk-like chat experience built with maintained `@nextcloud/vue` components * 📝 **Markdown rendering** — messages render Markdown, including inline replies shown as block quotes * 📎 **Nextcloud Smart Picker support** — insert files, links and other Nextcloud content directly into messages * 👥 **Group context inspector** — resolves a uniquely named ChurchTools group and shows its details together with matching Nextcloud Teams, linked folders and Deck boards * 😀 **Reactions & mentions** — react to messages with emoji and mention people with autocomplete * ⌨️ **Typing indicators & read receipts** — see when others are typing and whether direct messages have been read * 🔐 **Per-user ChurchTools credentials** — every user connects their own ChurchTools account; no shared or admin-level credentials are required
### 🚀 Setup
1. Install and enable the app as `churchtools_chat`. 2. As an administrator, open **Administration settings → Additional settings** and configure the ChurchTools tenant URL and the Matrix homeserver URL. 3. Each user then opens **Personal settings → Additional settings** and connects their own ChurchTools account.
📖 See the [README](https://github.com/samuelspagl/nextcloud-churchtools-chat#readme) for full setup and security details.
